_comment: Source of truth for Cy data handling. Update this whenever collection, storage, transmission, retention, or deletion changes. Policy wording requires human approval before release.
collects: Postcard text, an optional chosen handle, and an optional uploaded or Openverse-selected image voluntarily submitted by a visitor
A random visitor identifier in a signed HttpOnly cookie, used to recognise a returning postcard writer
IP addresses on postcard and rate-limit records for abuse prevention
Short-lived viewer-presence observations derived from event-stream polling
Owner-selected runner controls including tempo, day or night regime, pause state, and model provider
stores: The ordered public event stream, including screened Cy prose, prison events, public postcard fields, drawings, operational telemetry, and Soma snapshots containing current experienced-state values and their causal contributors
Private structured prison-world records separating objective event facts, Cy's observation, normalized categorical Soma input, and named consuming systems for the admin-only event inspector
Queued and delivered postcards, their reply-tray or fan-mail class, delivery, promotion and reply timestamps, submitted text, optional handle, moderation state, and rate-limit metadata
Uploaded or remotely selected postcard images re-encoded as WebP with metadata removed, plus source attribution when applicable
A returning visitor's postcard count, compact rolling notes, and legacy synthetic standing values

On the Dell runner, a bounded Soma episodic memory of up to 512 selected environmental events. An episode may contain postcard text or caption, a prison incident, a warden notice, or machine-continuity evidence, together with time, category, tags, and computed salience

On the Dell runner, learned event-family expectations, up to 128 bounded word associations learned from lived input, current attention and action, self-output action feedback, self-model evidence, eight experienced-state values with their causal contributor ledgers, and up to seven days of downsampled experienced-state history in the gitignored runtime state file

On the Dell runner, normalized homeostatic sleep pressure (Process S), its explicit uncertainty interval, current observed sleep state, model and provenance identifiers, last integration details, and up to seven days of post-installation Process S history

On the Dell runner, published circadian Process C metadata and evaluations, including the configured habitual wake basis, schedule-estimated CBTmin interval, mathematically derived circular phase interval, explicit phase uncertainty, model and provenance identifiers, and up to seven days of post-installation evaluation history
On the Dell runner, a rolling context of screened Cy-generated prose, operational logs, electricity and paid-provider spend totals, and retry queues

In the visitor's browser, only the numeric IDs, submission times, and waiting/responding state of that browser's postcards awaiting a reply, retained for at most 24 hours so waiting state survives a refresh

transmits.purpose: Deliver one selected reply item to Cy, screen and archive fan mail without prompting the model, and maintain the continuous process
transmits.data: Selected reply postcard text and image reference, chosen handle, returning-visitor memory and standing; fan-mail postcard content for screening and public archiving; warden notices, news, tempo, and owner controls

transmits.purpose: Publish the screened experience and maintain queued visitor interactions
transmits.data: Batched public events and private visitor, drawing, or structured prison-world write-backs from the Dell runner

transmits.recipient: DeepSeek, only while the owner has selected the optional remote provider
transmits.purpose: Generate Cy's prose or drawing instructions
transmits.data: The current prompt, which can include recent screened Cy prose, selected Soma attention and action, compact qualitative consequences of the strongest experienced-state contributors, recent incidents, incoming postcard text, and compact returning-visitor context

transmits.recipient: Openverse and the host of a selected public image
transmits.purpose: Search for a visitor-requested postcard image and fetch the selected public image
transmits.data: The visitor's image-search query is sent to Openverse; the selected image URL is then requested from its host

transmits.purpose: Render and replay the live or historical Cy experience
transmits.data: Screened public event-stream content, public reply postcards and fan-mail fields, drawings, operational telemetry, and Soma values labelled from the implementation registry as LIVE, PROVISIONAL, or NOT MODELLED

does_not_store: Raw uploaded image metadata after re-encoding
Model-provider API keys in the repository or public event stream
Blocked postcard text or blocked model output in the public event stream
A biological or clinical measurement of Cy; brain locations and legacy vitals are explicit analogies or planned synthetic values
notes: Process S consumes categorical sleep onset, waking, interruption, return-to-sleep and forced-wakefulness records. It is a sleep-homeostasis construct, not a biological measurement or validated subjective-fatigue score, and no old fatigue values are used to backfill it.

Process C is a deterministic published circadian waveform evaluated from clock time. Its biological phase is not observed; a phase interval is estimated from the configured habitual wake schedule, and public history curves are mathematically reconstructed from that stored basis rather than presented as biological measurements.

Process S and Process C remain separate. No equation combines them into the provisional fatigue value, and Process C does not alter Cy's language, mood, action selection, or other visitor-facing Soma variables.

Screened model text returns to Soma only as a bounded efference copy of Cy's action: repetition, intensity, commitments, and activation of word associations previously learned from lived input. Text sentiment cannot directly manufacture appraisal or emotional state.

Fan mail is retained and made publicly replayable after runner-side screening, but it is not treated as something Cy perceived and does not affect Soma unless it is later promoted into the reply tray.
Soma memory is bounded by count and preferentially retains salient older episodes alongside recent ones; a time-based deletion period is not currently implemented.
Policy wording generated from this manifest requires human review before release.
